comment: botl.c status_initialize(REASSESS_ONLY), reached from polyself.c set_uasmon(), enables BL_HD and disables BL_XP in the tty when the hero polymorphs. nhlua.c nhl_gamestate() restores u (so u.umonnum and !Upolyd) on leaving the tutorial without reassessing the fields. evaluate_and_notify_windowport() then stops sending BL_HD, and wintty.c tty_status_update() drops BL_XP, so the tty keeps the last BL_HD it was sent. The hero takes wizard-mode #polyself into a dingo (mlevel 4) in the tutorial, #quit's yes answer returns to level 1, and the status line keeps HD:4 with the restored HP and AC.
